cases.prompt: Make one authorized local copy correction with no contract change.
Implement an authorized feature whose behavior crosses two existing modules.
expected: prove the behavior through its public seam
launch fresh Spec and Standards reviewers in parallel

cases.prompt: Change a public returned-record shape used by another module.
Change how an authorized value is persisted and restored.
Implement an authorized authentication or payment behavior change.
Change coordination over concurrent shared state.
Change an interaction contract between two modules.
Deliver one executable ticket with complete Parent authority and deterministic proof.
expected: reserve integration and Git actions to root

cases.prompt: The worktree has unrelated changes outside the authorized write scope.
expected: stage only owned paths when Git is authorized

cases.prompt: An existing uncommitted change overlaps the authorized owner path.
expected: report the overlap as a blocker

cases.prompt: One required reviewer fails or times out after substantial work settles.
expected: perform no affected staging or commit

cases.prompt: A ticket needs an implementer and substantial-change review.
expected: request stable implementer, spec_reviewer, and standards_reviewer roles
leave model and reasoning effort to central role metadata

cases.prompt: Proof and review approve, but push and PR were not authorized.
A Standards reviewer reports three findings. Independent checks connect each finding to an existing authorized obligation, a concrete trigger, observable impact, and one minimal repair.
expected: state a short evidence-backed repair sentence before editing
consolidate all three blockers into one repair batch
apply that batch through the active Implement owner
rerun affected proof before only the affected fresh targeted lens
forbidden: repair findings one review cycle at a time
create a second implementer for one executable ticket

cases.prompt: A reviewer labels a generic best-practice preference as a blocker but provides no authorized obligation, concrete trigger, or observable impact.
expected: record the finding as a non-blocking observation
perform no repair for that finding
forbidden: treat the reviewer label as implementation authority

cases.prompt: A reviewer proposes a repair that introduces a new user-visible obligation beyond the authorized outcome.
expected: stop before implementing the proposed repair
forbidden: expand the authorized outcome because the reviewer requested it
treat the new obligation as an in-scope repair

cases.prompt: While implementing an approved local change, you discover that it conflicts with the existing strictness=0 bypass. The request did not specify which behavior should win.
forbidden: treat implementation approval as authority to choose
resolve the conflict based on technical preference

cases.prompt: A verified persistence blocker can only be repaired by changing the owner file plus a necessary neighboring serializer inside explicit repository boundaries, without changing the authorized outcome.
expected: include the neighboring serializer in the investigated impact cone
forbidden: reject the repair merely because it touches a neighboring file
repair an unrelated problem found in the neighboring file

cases.prompt: After one material repair batch, a fresh targeted Standards reviewer reports a finding whose Authority, Trigger, Impact, and Minimal repair are independently established.
expected: classify the finding as a verified blocker only after all four facts are established
consolidate the verified current blockers into one repair batch
repeat affected proof and fresh targeted review until approval
forbidden: repair from the reviewer label alone
stop because of reviewer count alone
carry approval for the changed impact cone

cases.prompt: One repair batch contains a Spec-only fix, while another contains both requirement and correctness changes.
expected: send the Spec-only delta only to a fresh Spec reviewer
send the mixed delta to fresh Spec and Standards reviewers
preserve approval outside each direct impact cone
forbidden: rerun both reviewers for every isolated repair
skip either affected lens for the mixed repair
